title: Bind us together Lord
lyrics_original: With cords that cannot be broken
That is why we sing.        ||Bind us||
Fit for the glory of God,
Born with the right to be free
For Jesus the victory has won.         ||Bind us||
We are the family of God
We are the glorious new wine.       ||Bind us||

bible_verses.telugu: ప్రభువునుబట్టి ఖైదీనైన నేను మిమ్మును బతిమాలు కొనుచున్నాను. శరీర మొక్కటే, ఆత్మయు ఒక్కడే; ఆ ప్రకారమే మీ పిలుపువిషయమై యొక్కటే నిరీక్షణ యందుండుటకు పిలువబడితిరి.
bible_verses.english: Make every effort to keep the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace. There is one body and one Spirit, just as you were called to one hope when you were called.

bible_verses.telugu: వీటన్నిటిపైన పరిపూర్ణతకు అను బంధమైన ప్రేమను ధరించుకొనుడి.
bible_verses.english: And over all these virtues put on love, which binds them all together in perfect unity.

bible_verses.telugu: ఒంటరి యగు నొకనిమీద మరియొకడు పడినయెడల ఇద్దరు కూడి వాని నెదిరింప గలరు, మూడు పేటల త్రాడు త్వరగా తెగిపోదు గదా?
bible_verses.english: Though one may be overpowered, two can defend themselves. A cord of three strands is not quickly broken.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, thank You for bringing us into one family through Your unconditional love. Bind our hearts tightly to Yours and to one another, so that our unity reveals Your grace to the world. Help me to choose love, patience, and kindness in my relationships today. May our shared life and worship glorify You, our one true God and King. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, thank You for bringing us into one family through Your unconditional love. devotional.reflection_english: In a world that often divides us, "Bind Us Together" reminds us of the profound unity we share in Christ. As one Body under one King, our connection is held by divine love—a cord that cannot be broken. When we worship alongside our brothers and sisters, we celebrate the grace that weaves our lives together. Today, let us open our hearts to love one another deeply, reflecting the oneness Christ has lovingly built among us.
